name: mplad-sentinel
description: MPLAD SENTINEL — AI-Powered MPLADS Risk Intelligence Platform (SIH 2026 PS 26102)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix backend" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend"
